collection.title: BMW 4 Series Cabrio 2014 to 2020 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A BMW 4 Series Cabrio 2014 - 2020 requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 18" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
